messages:
anya: Hi folks — planning a 120-day remote stay in Berlin (AprJul) to help family. Homebase would remain US. Do I need to change anything for WFH stipend, payroll withholding, or pension/social security?

rachel: welcome Q! If homebase stays US you'll still be eligible for the monthly WFH allowance but you must submit the Temporary Remote Location (TRL) form so payroll can pro-rate and note the dates.

anya: thanks. worried about that 120-day bit. iirc 90 days sometimes triggers employer reporting?

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-7901  "Berlin 120d: payroll/pension nexus check for anya"  assigned to marco. ETA 2 business days. :ticket:

marco: taking this. quick clarifying Qs: will you remain on USD payroll and not open a German bank account? any meetings with local customers or contractors?

anya: yes USD payroll, no local bank, no customer meetings, purely personal.

marco: ok. 120 days increases the chance of social security or reporting obligations in Germany. we'll consult local counsel re: potential employer registration or voluntary social security exposure. also check bilateral totalization (US-Germany) for pension implications.

viv: benefits note: your Redwood medical plan continues but routine local care in Germany isn't covered; emergency care is. telehealth should work but mind timezones.

rachel: stipend proration: monthly allowance pro-rates by days in the month. If your TRL spans part of April and all of May/June you'll see 3 entries with proration where applicable.

anya: what supporting docs should I attach to the TRL?

rachel: flight + booking is fine. if you have a longer-term rental attach the lease. a short note that you're not doing client-facing work helps legal.

anya: submitted TRL TL-5707 with flights and rental confirmation.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-7901  TL-5707 received, marco added note: USD payroll; awaiting legal counsel.

marco: legal follow-up: please refrain from onboarding local contractors or signing any German contracts while on TRL; that can change employer risk. if counsel requests additional attestation we'll ping you.

anya: understood. is there any effect on US tax withholding?

marco: generally none if payroll remains US and you stay tax resident in the US, but we'll flag for payroll/tax team to confirm whether any informational reports are recommended.

viv: ops aside: we don't ship company hardware overseas by default. if you need local connectivity we can pre-approve a one-time connection stipend up to $150 as an expense; upload receipts after purchase.

anya: appreciate that. last Q: any pension/totalization paperwork i should be aware of?

marco: good flag  for stays beyond 90 days local authorities sometimes check social security status. counsel will advise whether employer-level filings or totalization certificate interaction is needed. we'll update ticket with the advisory.

payroll-bot: #PR-7901 last updated 2176500028: awaiting legal counsel (marco).

anya: thanks team  TL-5707 done. will wait for the ticket update and avoid client meetings while abroad. :airplane:
